headline: 255 votes: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir elected as Bangladesh's 24th president
summary: The BNP candidate secured a decisive victory over the 11-party unity candidate Oli Ahmed, who received 88 votes.
details: BNP candidate Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir has been elected as the 24th President of Bangladesh, securing 255 votes in the National Parliament. His opponent, Oli Ahmed, representing an 11-party unity alliance led by Jamaat-e-Islami, received 88 votes.

The election took place on Thursday, where 343 out of 349 members of Parliament were present and voted. Six members remained absent, including independent MP Rumin Farhana and several BNP and Jamaat-e-Islami members.

Immediately after the results were announced, Prime Minister Tarique Rahman congratulated the President-elect with a red rose, while members of Parliament from both government and opposition parties exchanged greetings and embraces.
The Election Commission has issued a gazette notification declaring Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir as the president. He is scheduled to take the oath of office on Friday evening.
This election follows the resignation of President Mohammed Sahabuddin on July 24, due to health reasons. Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmed had been serving as the acting president since then.
The victory is seen as a significant event, with the Home Minister stating that this presidential election marks a new beginning for democracy in the country.

headline: Traffic alerts: DMP issues directives for President's swearing-in
summary: Special traffic restrictions will be in place around the Bangabhaban area from 3 PM to 9 PM this Friday to ensure smooth movement for guests.
details: The Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) has issued traffic directives for the swearing-in ceremony of the newly elected President, Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir, scheduled for Friday, August 21, at 7:30 PM at Bangabhaban.
caption:
Heading to the Bangabhaban area this Friday? Be aware of these traffic changes.

The Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) has issued traffic directives for the swearing-in ceremony of the newly elected President, Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir, scheduled for Friday, August 21, at 7:30 PM at Bangabhaban.
